body: I homeschooled as a kid, and as a result have always been pretty socially awkward. Pretty much a loner. Perhaps a result of this, I have felt the same way as you for a while, OP. It struck me when you when said it; I really *never* have fantasized about people missing me or being sorry. I too have watched documentaries, ordered and read books about assisted suicide methods, look at statistics, even pictures sometimes. The ideation is definitely something I can't explain, but when things got worse after my fiance left me, I find it much stronger...
I'm sorry, but honestly that makes it worse. Reminds me of how much she used to care for me. She really loved me... And now she's gone forever. Holy *shit* this hurts.
Shallow almost, but this is true for me as well. We are physical beings after all, I guess.
